concept: Digital Marketing Málaga's own cyan wave mark is the connection. It is one line that joins two people, gets lost in their topographic terrain, becomes DMM, strings their community, events and WhatsApp conversation together, and finally folds into a door that opens. Every move is built from their site's visual language: topographic charcoal, the wave and its dot, rounded photo cards at different heights, dark event banners, pill buttons and the white events list. No other community could own this film.
thread:
The logo's wave: a cyan gradient squiggle (#49D8ED→#9EE6FD) with a lower first hump, a taller second hump, an end hook and a separate dot. Its path through the film:
- 0.0: it draws itself on their topographic charcoal.
- 0.8: it stretches into the line between two people.
- 3.3: it snaps on a ridge of contour lines, searches, and ties itself into a knot on "easy".
- 5.8: the knot pulls straight and springs back into the mark as the serif logotype builds around it.
- 8.7: it stretches across the frame and the hero's photo cards land on its peaks and valleys.
- 11.3: it pulls back into its dot. The dot pins Málaga on the contour map, then opens into the white events page.
- 13.7: it underlines a talk's headline.
- 16.45: it joins the speakers' names.
- 17.85: it becomes a speech bubble's tail and voice, then forks into paths to the member perks and presses "WhatsApp group".
- 20.3: it is the voice-note waveform, the bubble tails and the typing dots in the chat.
- 23.7: it climbs a staircase of their pills, grows taller humps like the logo's own second hump, and its dot lights up.
- 28.4: it links the two people from the opening again and folds up into the outline of a door that opens onto cyan light.
- 32.4: it draws itself back into the logo exactly as on frame 0 and grows on "grow together", with rings rippling from its dot to the last frame.
colour_plan:
Three fields in the site's own order (dark hero, white content, dark footer). Every change is a mask that grows out of an object, never a crossfade.
- 0–12.6: charcoal #2C2C31 with their calm topographic lines. Cyan is the only colour. This covers the connection, the search and DMM's own world.
- 12.62: the Málaga pin opens into a white #F5F5F5 circle, their white events section. It is the daylight of the in-person part: banners, the event room, speakers, sharing and the phone. The dark banners and the charcoal phone stand out on it.
- 23.15: the phone's topographic wallpaper zooms through and becomes the charcoal stage again, for the personal, aspirational part, where the cyan wave reads at its best.
- 30.2–30.8: the opened door floods the frame with the full cyan gradient #49D8ED→#9EE6FD. This is the one accent field, kept for the moment that matters: the new door.
- 30.85: that cyan condenses into the JOIN US pill and reveals the charcoal topographic footer for the end card.

Type is white on charcoal, and charcoal on white and on cyan. On white, the wave uses the deeper #49D8ED end and a thicker stroke for contrast.

scenes.vo: but finding your people isn't always easy.
scenes.idea: Their topographic texture becomes the obstacle. The contour lines bunch into a steep ridge between the two people, the wave that joined them snaps, and its dot searches along the contours until it ties itself into a knot on 'easy'. One line, one terrain and two dimmed people: the difficulty reads with the sound off.

The logotype builds and the wave draws itself back into the logo exactly as on frame 0. It then grows on 'Let's grow together', with rings rippling from its dot to the last frame.
beats: 30.85 the full cyan field contracts toward the centre into a pill (1920x1080 → 560x150, corner radius rising over the middle of the move, 0.3 s), revealing the charcoal topographic footer behind it; 'JOIN US' (Albert Sans 600, 56 px, charcoal, +4% tracking) rises inside 3 frames after the pill settles
31.14 ('Join') the pill is pressed (scale 1→0.94→1, spring damping 16) and a cyan ring ripples from it across the contour lines; camera push 1.00→1.04 (31.2→33.2, INOUT)
31.50 ('Digital') the pill eases down to y=880 and shrinks to 400x108 (0.5 s) as 'Digital' rises in the serif logotype above (lockup ≈700x410, centred at (960,400))
31.96 ('Marketing') 'Marketing' rises
32.38 ('Málaga') 'Málaga' rises, and the wave draws itself on after it from its left cap, exactly as on frame 0 (first hump, taller second hump, hook; 0.45 s)
32.92 (end of 'Málaga') the dot pops in as the full stop

33.34 ('Let's') 'Let's grow together.' rises under the logo word by word at y=690 (Albert Sans 700, 92 px, white, with 'together' in cyan); the URL 'digitalmarketingmalaga.com' (Albert Sans 500, 36 px, grey #9A999E) fades up under the pill at y=975
33.70 ('grow') the logo's wave grows: its second hump rises 18% (0.6 s, soft)
33.82 ('together') rings start rippling out of the wave's dot through the contour lines, one every 0.7 s, fading as they spread
34.50 a second ring leaves the dot; the contour lines keep flowing slowly
35.00 a glint runs once along the wave's gradient (0.6 s)
35.60 a third ring leaves; the camera's breath eases toward rest; the logo itself rests
36.20 a fourth ring is still spreading on the last frame (36.4): nothing is still

scenes.transition_out: End of film. The end card holds its layout while rings keep spreading from the wave's dot to the last frame (no fade).
scenes.sfx: gen-whoosh-short (a reversed feel) for the contraction at 30.85; gen-tap on the press at 31.14 with a soft gen-swell ring; a soft gen-tap on 'Digital', 'Marketing' and 'Málaga'; gen-success on the dot at 32.92; a soft gen-chime on 'together' at 33.82; gen-shimmer for the glint at 35.0. The music bed resolves and rings out to 36.4.

risks: Motion norm: the two line-only stretches will measure low: the knot and logo (2.9–8.6) and the ambitions (23.2–27.8). At 60 fps, the thin wave and the dim contour lines hardly register in motion_check.py, which scales to 160x90 and counts a pixel only if it changed by more than 6 grey levels. The norm comes from the photo cards, banners, phone and colour masks. If this film's target is the usual 7%, raise it with motion that means something (strokes of 36–44 px, bigger pills, cards that keep acting), never with drift, and report the median honestly.

Calm background vs Topo actions: the ridge (S2), the summit rings (S5, S10) and the ripples all transform the background. Keep them slow (B3, 1.2 s or more) and low-contrast (lines at 14% cyan at most) so the foreground still leads. If Topo's densify only works on the whole field, the ridge will read as noise; it needs a local band.

Kit additions requested: (a) a Wave tangle state: three clean loops, sampled with the same point count as the mark, so the knot can unwind through a straight line into the mark (S2–S3). (b) A Door: a rounded-top outline drawn by the wave, a panel with the topographic texture that swings in 3D (perspective about 1600 px), and a light wedge whose opening grows into a full-frame mask (S11). The S8 speech bubble with a wave tail can reuse Phone's bubble.

Logo fidelity: the logo PNG is only 302 px wide. The serif logotype must be rebuilt as vector, traced or matched to the site's serif. The wave must be traced from dmm-icon.png: lower first hump, taller second hump, end hook, separate dot, gradient #49D8ED→#9EE6FD. An approximate serif will look off-brand at caps of 110 px.

Sharpness: only the 2026 banners (2,091–2,178 px) are shown large; the 2025 banners (about 700 px) are not used. The cathedral photo (714 px) stays at or below 500 px on screen, and Alexandra's portrait (564 px) is not used. The speaker crops from the banners must stop above the name and title printed at the bottom of each photo half.

Readability of the banner flips: the first two flips last about 0.42 s each, so those headlines are glimpsed as a stream of ideas, which is intended. Only Charlie's banner holds long enough to read. If Karl wants every headline read, drop one banner.

Cyan on white (#49D8ED on #F5F5F5) is low contrast, about 1.6:1. In the white section the wave and underlines use the deeper end of the gradient and thicker strokes, and the pills carry charcoal text.

People: the opening pair, who return at the door, is the unnamed woman from their hero and organizer Diego Rodríguez (unnamed in those shots). If Karl prefers two members rather than an organizer, swap card B for another site photo.

Facts: on screen there are only words from the script and items from facts.md: the speaker names and talk titles, the date '2026-10-15 19:00:00', 'About 240 active members', the member perks, JOIN US and the URL. The chat holds no invented messages, only images, a link preview, a voice-note wave and typing dots. WhatsApp is named, but its logo and green UI are not used; the chat is in DMM's brand.

Busy frames: S8 (card, bubble, fork and three pills) and S9 (phone, four messages and type at the side) are the densest. Keep the pills big, send the group card out as the phone rises, and let one thing lead at a time.

Type rolls: the top slot rolls about ten times in the film. Keep each roll a short drop-through (0.25 s) and consistent, and give each line a key word that acts (cyan, pinned or marked), so the slot reads as one system rather than as subtitles.
